info.name: Edu SaaS - Self Enrollment Fixture + Tests
info.description: Setup-and-test collection for the current university self-enrollment flow. Run the admin setup requests in order, then login as the created student and run the student self-enrollment requests. Member creation uses the live member flow and therefore requires email sending to be configured in this backend. If you already have student users/memberships, you can skip member creation and fill studentMemberId/studentToken manually.

request.description: Login with an existing admin user that belongs to the target university institution.
This assumes the target institution does not already have another active semester.
Creates the student user/member. Initial login password is the same as profile.nationalNumber.
